findings.title: Generic update bypasses Core lifecycle authority through the actual host repository
findings.repro: Actual public handle + actual Core KnowledgeRepositoryImpl, with memory-only Drizzle and entity readback. update(id,{lifecycle:active}) changes pending→active with updateCalls=1, readinessCalls=0 and ok:true.
findings.minimalFix: Agent入口拒绝Core管理的生命周期字段；优先公开Core规则/常量，若无公开字段列表只做明确输入边界拒绝，不复制状态机。普通更新仍需真正host service adapter，不能把raw repository当完整管理服务。
tests: 通过实际handle传lifecycle等受管理字段，write端口不调用、readiness/publish不绕过。
普通明确可编辑字段继续原调用，避免把所有update变成空壳。
findings.implementedFix: Explicit Agent content-edit allowlist matches all 28 current Core KnowledgeService.update UPDATABLE fields. Every non-permitted own key is rejected as a whole, including stats, stagingDeadline, lifecycle and explicit undefined; no stripping/partial application. Core business validation, tag merging and persistence are not reimplemented.

findings.title: Partial Core persistence is lost or falsely marked unchanged
findings.repro: Actual Core StagingManager + in-memory fileStore success + repository.update failure yields STATE_DIVERGENCE with fileOpsCompleted:1, entryIds, operation, reconcileVia. Public review rejects Promise; public publish given the same typed error reports lifecycle:unchanged and drops details.
findings.minimalFix: 规范化错误保留Core code/details与readback/reconcile依据；readiness阻断等写前路径可说unchanged，publish已进入后的一般异常应unknown/partial，不能推断rollback。
tests: 普通publish失败不伪称unchanged；已确认成功后取消继续返回成功事实+degraded诊断。

findings.title: Review services escape the ToolResult boundary and review-queue cannot settle on cancellation
findings.repro: listReviewQueue/recordReview throw store unavailable → public handle Promise rejects. A pending listReviewQueue remains unsettled after abort; it only returns aborted failure after the underlying read eventually resolves.
findings.minimalFix: review/queue统一catch到结构化ToolResult；只读queue用shared runOperation响应取消并丢弃迟到结果。写入review一旦开始继续等待真实receipt，不伪称rollback或取消成功写入。
tests: 普通服务异常resolve为fail，不reject公开handle。
pending queue在abort后及时settle，迟到数据不成为成功响应。
pre-abort不调用端口；review已开始后返回true仍recorded:true并标degraded；false保持not-in-staging失败。

findings.title: Invalid explicit management inputs reach mutation ports or are silently defaulted
findings.repro: score NaN/Infinity/string high forwarded unchanged and ok:true with mock score port. deprecate confidence80 through actual Core ProposalGateway invokes immediate transition. numeric/object/blank id reaches proposalGateway through direct handle. queue limit0.5 becomes0, -1/Infinity/string silently becomes undefined.
findings.minimalFix: 统一management输入归一：id为非空string；score至少实际finite number；显式confidence须finite0..1，缺席才默认；显式limit须合法正整数，缺席保留原默认，不新增队列策略。registry提供相应字段说明/约束但handler仍自己校验。
tests: 非法显式数值/类型零端口写入；有效0/1等边界保留。
confidence缺席保留旧default；非法data.confidence不能偷偷落到top-level/default。
data.score缺席不隐式写0；合法分数不发明新范围。

findings.title: Core skipped outcome is described as a successful proposal and its reason is dropped
findings.repro: Actual Core ProposalGateway.create returns null and no richer evidence → outcome skipped,error Duplicate proposal or creation failed. handle returns ok:true,status evolution_proposed,outcome skipped with no error reason.
findings.minimalFix: skipped显式投影为非proposal状态并保留Core原因；不能把重复跳过统一当error重试，也不能编造proposalId。现有proposal-created/upgraded/immediately-executed/verified兼容状态保留。
tests: Core正常四类成功各映射正确；evolution统计继续不把skipped计成功。

findings.title: Actual host repository does not implement declared management methods
findings.repro: Actual Core repository instance has reject/score/validate/getById undefined and update function. Public handle reject/score/validate returns generic repo.X is not a function.
findings.minimalFix: 本仓先结构化报端口不可用、做typeof方法检查；不得造repo alias实现或改用未确认等价Core操作。跨仓需正式host管理service adapter，用户授权后另行接入。getById读fallback本轮不扩。
tests: 存在的旧可用端口仍可调用；不因本仓零引用删公开动作。

actualCallerMap.flow: Alembic AgentModule creates @alembic/agent ToolRouterAdapter with host ToolContextFactory → factory injects Core repository/stagingManager/proposalGateway → Agent registry knowledge.manage → public handle → handleManage
review → Core StagingManager.recordReview → persistKnowledgeUpdate → commitKnowledgeWrite(file first, DB commit/readback second)
evolve/deprecate/skip_evolution → Core ProposalGateway.submit(update/deprecate/valid); Core owns immediate-vs-proposal policy and dedup/upgrade
approve/publish → Core RecipeProductionPort.evaluateReadiness/publish → KnowledgeService lifecycle guard and file-first write; Agent must not infer rollback from an exception

agent.coverage: Evolution source defaults/legacy/domain vocabulary through real router; does not test invalid numeric inputs or skipped errors.
readiness preflight, publish, typed readiness errors and cancellation; no review/review-queue service failure coverage found.
Outcome accounting already gives Core skipped priority over misleading legacy proposed status.

coreReadOnly.coverage: real staging review success/false, queue exclusion, pass/fail/missing promotion semantics.

retainedSemantics: review-queue不需要id；已review条目由Core筛除，不在Agent重写队列策略。
review返回false表示非staging/不存在；true是Core确认写入，取消后不能抹掉。
Core无signal的写入已开始后等待真实结果；只读等待可取消。
approve/publish仍必须Core readiness+publish；不可回退到repo生命周期字段更新。
没有partial信息时不能凭异常文本猜测持久化成功；保留unknown与Core typed details。

simplificationRecommendations.title: 使用公开Core端口词汇

hostIntegrationAdvice.required: 将普通知识管理动作接到明确、可审计的KnowledgeService/公开能力port，携带真实user/context；保留raw repository供读基础数据但不得冒充生命周期服务。
